rationale: C25 is a concrete and material drafting template for the child. Both proclamations concern a state's milestone anniversary of statehood, identify a state-sponsored exposition, describe participation as promoting commerce and peaceful international relations, cite a congressional joint resolution authorizing invitations, invoke the governor's request, and issue a substantially parallel invitation to participate. C20 and C16 share narrower portions of the celebration machinery, but neither matches the child's complete state-anniversary framework as closely as C25.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the year 1959 will mark the one hundredth anniversary of statehood for Oregon ... and the Legislative Assembly of that State has provided for a Centennial Celebration ... [including] the Oregon Centennial Exposition and International Trade Fair
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the State of Oklahoma will celebrate its fiftieth anniversary of statehood ... and will hold, as a part of such celebration, the Oklahoma Semi-Centennial Exposition
shared_material.explanation: Both establish the same factual structure: a statehood anniversary, a statewide celebration, and an exposition conducted as part of it.

shared_material.child_excerpt: will stimulate industry, will promote trade and peaceful relationships with other peoples
shared_material.parent_excerpt: will contribute to our national welfare by promoting foreign and domestic commerce and by furthering harmonious and peaceful relationships with the peoples and nations of the world
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C25's distinctive pairing of commercial promotion with peaceful international relationships.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Congress of the United States, by a joint resolution ... authorized the President ... to issue a proclamation calling upon the people to commemorate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Congress by joint resolution ... has authorized the President ... by proclamation ... to invite the States of the Union and foreign countries to participate
shared_material.explanation: Both use a congressional joint resolution as the immediate authority for a presidential proclamation encouraging participation in the state celebration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: pursuant to the joint resolution of Congress and the request of the Governor of Oregon ... I also invite the States of the Union, and our Territories and possessions to participate in the Celebration
shared_material.parent_excerpt: pursuant to the aforesaid joint resolution of Congress and at the request of the Governor of the State of Oklahoma, do hereby invite the States of the Union and foreign countries to participate
shared_material.explanation: This is a close literal and structural match in the operative clause, with the state, invited participants, and event details adapted.
